title: Multiple Job Board Scraper input
description: Use this when you need a single, normalized job dataset from several public job boards.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Use this when you want matching role or skill keywords.

location.title: Location
location.description: Use this to prefer jobs whose location text matches; Remote is accepted.

sources.title: Job boards
sources.description: Use this to choose public job boards. Unavailable boards return a partial result without discarding other data.

maxResults.title: Maximum jobs
maxResults.description: Use this to cap saved results and billable job events.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Use this to include a cleaned, capped job description.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
